request:

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string), inheritance_depth (integer).
explanation: Recursively walks class_bases starting from the ClickException class symbol in src/click/exceptions.py, incrementing depth at each inheritance step. It then keeps only classes located under src/click/ and returns each symbol with its minimum depth (1 for direct subclasses).
